sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
An Ashina trade promissory note. Matabei Anayama's last piece of product.
Discounts the cost of items when purchasing from merchants.
A sen saved is a sen earned. And so long as one draws breath, business will continue.
Sold by Anayama the Peddler for 1 1. Requires Kotaro to have been sent to him to work and is only available for purchase during the last encounter with him during the siege on Ashina Castle.
Gives Wolf a 10% discount with all merchants (does not affect Prosthetic Tool upgrades).
